filecards.note: Implemented inside the pinned engine binary; the manifest declares capabilities.

fastcards.note: SQLite store inside the pinned engine binary (§7.1 builtin-store amendment). Machine-local state — see the manifest's state_portability and the README.

beads.note: Ships in-template; PR + owner review is the pin (control surface). Externally installed copies must carry a sha256 (seed backend verify).

paperclip.note: Ships in-template; PR + owner review is the pin (control surface). Server-backed: requires_env credentials, no offline.

linear.note: Ships in-template; PR + owner review is the pin (control surface). Server-backed (GraphQL): requires_env credentials, no offline; requires the custom Blocked workflow state.
